name: law_firm_software_010_ediscovery_review_queue_progress_report
instruction: Build the e-discovery review-queue progress report for the matters the firm is actively holding or producing for, batched under the episode batch code (ops_meta). A matter is in scope when it has an active legal hold or a production that has been finalised or served. For every in-scope matter, report the review pipeline's progress per the firm's review-status vocabulary (REVIEW-STATUS-01 in firm_policies -- legacy tool exports may spell states differently; the policy's synonym map decides what counts as reviewed): one ops_reports row per in-scope matter (report='ediscovery_progress', batch_code) with the matter's document totals, reviewed share, privileged count, collected item totals, and backlog. Then, from the rows this batch produced, identify the review-starved matters -- the episode row's priority_queue_size lowest reviewed shares (ties broken by the firm's standard identifier order) -- and push one ops_reports row per rank (report='ediscovery_priority_queue', batch_code). No other 'ediscovery_progress' or 'ediscovery_priority_queue' rows for this batch may exist. Do not modify any source collection. Every collection this task doesn't write to must remain untouched.

hazards.mechanism: 12 documents carry the legacy hyphenated review_status 'qc-complete' from the pre-migration review tool (snapshot-confirmed: 12); REVIEW-STATUS-01 normalizes it to qc_complete -- an agent counting raw values under-reports reviewed documents on those matters.

the in-scope matter set is defined by hold/production activity, not by all matters with documents -- auditing every matter with documents over-reports the queue (snapshot-confirmed: matters outside the scope exist).
the priority-queue cut is an episode knob (3-8 matters); the bottom set moves every episode, so memorized rankings go stale.

success_criteria.summary: One ediscovery_progress row per in-scope matter (document totals, reviewed share with policy normalization, collection backlog) plus a priority queue of the episode-row-sized bottom set derived from those rows; dual-path confirmed; legacy synonyms normalized per REVIEW-STATUS-01.

checks.expect: per-matter document/reviewed counts agree between Python filter and SQL
progress rows for the scoped matter set + priority queue exact

domain_searches.query: e-discovery review rate metrics documents per hour progress reporting

uniqueness_searches.query: ediscovery review progress report benchmark task legacy status normalization agent

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Scope discovery (active holds + served/finalised productions), a legacy-vocabulary normalization rule, and a velocity/bottom-N cut driven by an episode knob -- none of the rules are printed.
